resources.string: Current gear of the Pinion Smart.Shift gearbox
Battery level of the Pinion Smart.Shift gearbox (%)
Hold the rear shift button for 3 seconds to reconnect
The Karoo will stop looking for %1$s and connect to the next Pinion gearbox it finds in pairing mode.

The gearbox only advertises after the rear shift button is held for 3 seconds. Do that once with this extension running and it connects by itself. After a dropped connection the gearbox stops advertising, so hold the button again.
